annotations.title: The man hath appeared.
annotations.text: Al ancient fathers and Catholique writers ſay, this was an Angel, which appeared in the forme of a man, and it is plaine by this text. [1] Yet ſome proteſtantes wil haue this perſon to be Chriſt, the eternal word of God. [2]VVho afterwardes became man. And neuertheles where by & by (v. 16.) he admonisheth Manue to offer ſacrifice to God, they note that he ſought not his owne honour but Gods, vvhoſe meſſenger he vvas: either plainly contradicting themſelues, or els teaching Arrianiſme, as though the Sonne of God were not God; or inferiour to God the Father.

notes.text: Protestantes either contradict themselues, or teach Arrianisme.
